high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram Explore feed, showcasing a sponsored post by the account "wallmantra." The post features a wall-mounted wooden world map with a backlit design, creating a glowing effect that highlights the continents. The map has a walnut finish, giving it a warm, natural appearance. The setting appears to be a modern dining room or a similar space. The wall where the map is mounted is plain and light-colored, which contrasts nicely with the dark wood of the map. Below the map, there is a long wooden dining table set for four people.
